posts.text: So proud of what we made!

Kathy Dong, Brianna Xiao, Jasmine Zhu and I won Best Hardware Hack at SheHacks+ 10! 🤖 If Iron Man can move holographic screens with a wave of a hand, why can’t we? Traditional input devices aren’t designed for everyone or every context. Our project, AirClick, provides a more intuitive and inclusive way of interacting with technology by letting you control any device using just your hand.
